_note: German (du, lower case; German capitalisation; „…“ for quotation marks), not yet reviewed by a German speaker. The glossary is in docs/translating.md. The Settings window: its list of pages in four groups (Saal, Auf dem Bildschirm, Verbinden, Erweitert) and what each row says at its end (Ein, Aus, aktiv; short forms where the row is narrow), Set up SoftPresenter, and the pages Bildschirme, Folien, Liedteile, Sprache, Tasten, Befehlszeile, Lieddateien and Info.
